perunit_arrays.name: hr_xy_list
perunit_arrays.note: .hrstate: header 0x1193000 (magic HRT1,gen,tick..) then WORD x,y list of qualifying units built by scanning ALL exist slots (hrcode 0x1190800, 0x1191280; a16code 0x19b4b6a) with NO capacity check; count dword 0x119301c. Capacity 1200 entries before hr_unit. Must grow to 4093 entries when exist-end sentinels move.

perunit_arrays.name: hr_unit
perunit_arrays.note: .hrstate per-slot 64B records (gen,id,type|owner,..) indexed slot<<6 (+0x11942e0); immediately follows hr_xy_list; section end 0x11a6ee0. Also used by skcode/healai/cpcomba/atkfix/a16code. a16code 0x19b5718 uses [edx+edx+base] with magic-divide slot. No bulk clear (generation scheme).

perunit_arrays.name: sk_unit
perunit_arrays.note: .skstate: header 0x11ab000..0x11ab010; per-slot 24B. ENCODED base: lea edi,[slot+0xbc756]; *3; shl 3 (0x11a79e7) -> must be rewritten (new_base/0x18). Clear loop 0x11a7999..0x11a79dc end sentinel 0x11b2094 (6 dword stores/entry; dwords listed = 1200*6).

perunit_arrays.name: heal_slot
perunit_arrays.note: .healst: header 0x11bc000..0x11bc020; per-slot 24B via ENCODED lea edi,[slot+0xbd2ac];*3;shl 3 (0x11b7d3c). Gate 0x11b7af0 span.

perunit_arrays.name: heal_id
perunit_arrays.note: .healst tail: 16B per unit id via ENCODED (id+0x11c30a)<<4 at 0x11b78ed,0x11b7f42,0x11b8213; no direct operand to 0x11c30a0. Ids gated by 0x11b747a (id-1<=0x4ae). End = .healst end 0x11c7ba0.

perunit_arrays.name: army_slot
perunit_arrays.note: .armyst: header 0x11d4000 (gen 0x11d4004, widely read incl. atkfix/airfix/a16code), per-owner 8x0x1e68 at 0x11d4020 (not per-unit), then per-slot 24B at 0x11e3360 ([slot*3*8]). Only the per-slot tail needs growth.

perunit_arrays.name: cp_a
perunit_arrays.note: .cpstate: header 0x1200000..0x1200010; per-slot 28B (slot*7*4). Refs also in .airfix (0x1273bb4.., 0x1273e88) and .a16code (0x19b8330,0x19dead6.., 0x19dee98).

perunit_arrays.name: cp_b
perunit_arrays.note: .cpstate second per-slot array 20B ([slot*5*4]); end 0x120e110 = section end. a16code 0x19b2005/0x19ba005 mov esi,base and 0x19b2395 lea.

perunit_arrays.name: bs_slot
perunit_arrays.note: .bsstate: header 0x1230000..0x1230018 + per-owner 8x0x88 (0x1230018..0x1230458, clear loop end 0x123045c) stay; per-slot 40B [slot*5*8+0x1230458] gated by 0x1222801.

perunit_arrays.name: farm_slot
perunit_arrays.note: .farmst: header 0x1250000..0x1250008 + per-owner 8x12B (0x1250008..0x1250068); per-slot 16B (slot<<4) at 0x123e92e. Clear loop 0x123e1ae..0x123e1c9 end sentinel 0x1254b68 (1 dword per 16B entry). Slot NOT gated <1200 (only 0x11c85c0 exist check).

perunit_arrays.name: idl_slot
perunit_arrays.note: .idldata: header 0x1158000..0x1158010; 8B per slot walked with ecx+=8 in loop bounded by 0x1157150. memset 0x960 dwords (body only) -> 4093*2=0x1ffa.

perunit_arrays.name: rsidle_slot
perunit_arrays.note: .rsidle: tick header 0x1171000; 16B per slot. memset 0x12c4 dwords covers header+body -> (0x10+4093*16)/4=0x3ff8.

perunit_arrays.name: kill_log
perunit_arrays.note: .killdat: 32B per slot (slot<<5). Followed by 256x16B portrait table 0x1165600 (not per-unit) and misc 0x1170c00. Save writes 0xa600 bytes from 0x115c000 (0x115b3eb..0x115b422), load reads 0xa600 into staging 0x1166600 then FNV check and copies 0x2980 dwords (0x115b4bd..0x115b4cc); clear 0x2980 dwords covers log+portrait table. Growth changes save format and staging size.

perunit_arrays.name: mv_state
perunit_arrays.note: .mvstate: header 0x1182000..0x1182014; 40B per slot [slot*5*8+0x1182014], gate 0x1181421 span. No bulk clear.

perunit_arrays.name: we_cache
perunit_arrays.note: .wecache: 16B per unit id via helper 0x1149000 (id<1200 gate 0x1149007; returns 0 otherwise). Only operand is add edi,0x114c000.

perunit_arrays.name: psn_cache
perunit_arrays.note: .psndata (writable data, not BSS): per-slot 16B portrait cache inside the saved PSN2 blob 0x1100000..0x1116000 (save size 0x16000, clear 0x5800 dwords). Cannot grow in place (0x1112000 used). skcode 0x11a7d26 uses ENCODED base (slot+0x110c00)<<4; a16code 0x19a972b/0x19a973b read it.

perunit_arrays.name: enc16_list
perunit_arrays.note: In writable code section .enc16: header 0x1140800 (tick),0x1140804,0x1140808 (count); list of unit POINTERS of type 0x4c built by 0x113d1a0 (slot loop 0x113d243) without capacity check. Space before .enc16 data at 0x1143000 = 2048 entries; 4092 entries would overrun data/code at 0x1143000/0x1144000.

hazards.what: enc16_list append without capacity check; bound only by slot loop 0x113d243
hazards.why: Raising loop to 4093 without moving list overruns .enc16 data/code beyond 0x1143000.

hazards.what: farm_slot indexed by slot=(ptr-pool)/0x758 with no <1200 gate (validator 0x11c85c0 only checks exist/hp)
hazards.why: Any unit in slot >=1200 writes past .farmst end (0x1254b68); farm_slot must grow.

hazards.what: armyrot validator derives slot from pointer without span check, used as sole gate by farmer/adaptxp callers
hazards.why: Fine for exist (relocated) but provides no 1200 bound for module arrays.
Mechanical relocation will not see it; must be rewritten to new_base/0x18 (base must stay 0x18-aligned).

hazards.what: psn_cache indexed via encoded (slot+0x110c00)<<4 from unit ebx without visible <1200 gate in function
hazards.why: Slot >=1200 reads past cache into other .psndata (read-only); encoded base must be rewritten when cache relocates.

hazards.what: kill_log saved/loaded as fixed 0xa600-byte blob (with 0x1165600 portrait table) via staging 0x1166600
hazards.why: Growing kill_log needs save format/staging/size changes (0xa600, 0x2980) or a sidecar.

hazards.what: psn_cache lives inside fixed 0x16000-byte PSN2 save blob 0x1100000
hazards.why: Growth requires relocation + separate save sidecar (as 2608 port did).

Selection buffer 0x1604004 (.f2data, 1200 dwords of unit ids, ends 0x16052c4) kept at 1200: OK only if selection count stays capped (ESL cap 100). Owner of .f2data should confirm.

hrcode/skcode entry points jmp to .a16code which jumps back into hrcode bodies (0x1190ee8, 0x11916b6, 0x11a7415, 0x11a7776); a16code may hold its own 1200 bounds for these arrays (other agent).
a16code iterates hr_unit in parallel with pool (mov eax,0x1194338 = hr_unit+0x58, edi=0x66c3f0); loop bound lives in a16code (other agent) and must match grown hr_unit.
army_slot growth only moves per-slot tail 0x11e3360; header/per-owner 0x11d4000..0x11e3360 stays. Confirm no a16code/atkfix code indexes the tail by slot (only header refs seen).
cstxt/csright read byte [unit-0x72] after add edx,0x66b790 (0x1153a3d,0x1154459): odd negative field; compares owner. Mechanical pool relocation should still cover it.
